name: Akira
source:
Has a regular job at an office. But she’s always searching the thrill of adventure, so she doesn’t mind joining some shady groups and doing dangerous tasks, provided they do it for the greater good and not for mean causes.

She’s cheerful and talkative, and really good with computers, to the point of being a decent hacker. She’s also a bit hyperactive, and prefers following than leading.

[From Casting Call]
